column2: This long-legged beauty stands silently waiting for its jet-faced owner to return.
It looks like it came from the Planet of the Warts! This ship must be the Plantars Deluxe model with authentic Mosaic upholstery.
This must be the entrance to this building.
Boy, that was close!
You don't know what it says but you're sure it's not flattering.
This must be the back of the bar. Some fading graffiti adorns the wall.
Back here, the bar smells like everything they didn't want stinking up the front.
An interesting mix of flavors! Stale Keronian ale, regurgitated Keronian ale, and Keronian ale that's otherwise been used and disposed of.
You see the Droids-B-Us store in the distance.
From here, you can't really smell the Droids-B-Us building.
You'll have to get closer if you want to lick the Droids-B-Us building.
Licking a timepod that's just emerged from the chronostream is like sticking your tongue in a curling iron.
You give the Time Pod a long glance. It resembles an overgrown titanium tennis shoe. A tinted glass shield seals the top.
It smells like a time pod broiling in the Ulence sun.
This closely resembles the left side of Droids-B-Us.
It smells like an old lawsuit coming back to haunt the Two Guys From Andromeda.
Taste-tempting stucco! And what a nice sanding job it does on your tongue!
It's got the dry, musty smell of a store that's filed for Chapter XI.
The poor taste of the building is only matched by the poor taste of the architect.
The gate is down, the store is closed.
For all of your droid-related needs see us - when we're open!
The sign indicates that this establishment is not open for business.
Hey! Aren't you the guy who broke my slot machine? You owe me some money!
Hi.
Well, I've gotta run. My Hog Pod's double parked. It's been swell talking to you.

There's some writing on the wall above the stairs. It says..." " Quality Assurance by: Mike Harian Dan Scott Tate Deloach Keri Cooper Bill Shockley Neil Matz Gordon Owens Dave Fleming Danny Woolard Chris Carr John Ratcliffe Robin Bradley Joe Perry Mike Pickhinke Sharon Smith Sharon Simmons Kevin Ray
The old bar is still here. The smell of Keronian Ale stinks up the place. The aroma leads you to remember vividly your previous visit here. You break out in a cold sweat.
Your attempt to get the matches failed.
You pick up the book of matches.
You see the bar's floor.
This looks like the bar in Space Quest I.
There's some writing on the wall above the stairs. Perhaps it says: Watch Your Step.
Some rather drab-looking individuals are hogging the bar. This guy's really ugly!
Some rather drab-looking individuals are hogging the bar. This guy's too ugly to describe!
Some rather drab-looking individuals are hogging the bar. This guy's the ugliest of all!
There is a stage here with two guys singing.
There's the bar just as you remember it.
You see a book of matches on the bar countertop.
The bartender, due to the lack of resolution, is a plain man nearly devoid of features.
You see a man behind the bar serving drinks.
You have no time for a drink.
You step over to talk to the bartender. As you do, you attract the attention of the crude fellows at the bar.
You don't want to get into that mess again.
A truly groovy band cranks out tired old tunes.
You see two guys singing.
The band members have nothing of interest.
They don't have time to talk right now.
Fortunately, they play much better than they smell.
They are not interested in that.
You don't have enough to afford their services.
From your position in the bar, you can only see sky through the window.
It's an incremental elevation adjustment device.
Well, lookee here! If it ain't Mister Look-at-me-I'm-in-VGA.
Hey, fellas! I bet I can toss him all the way out from the bottom of the stairs. Bet ya an ale.
Well, lookee here! If it ain't Mister Look-at-me-I'm-in-32 colors.
Whatsamatter, monochrome not good enough for you?
What's dis? 32 colors all for one little bitmapped WIMP?! Whatta waste of EGA. Har, har!
What's dis? 256 colors all for one little bitmapped WIMP?! Whatta waste of VGA. Har, har!
Well, lookee here! If it ain't Mister Look-at-me-I'm-in-EGA.
What's dis? 16 colors all for one little bitmapped WIMP?! Whatta waste of EGA. Har, har!
Mr. Carlos sent me. I want to know about the sheep.
As much as we enjoy seeing you get in trouble, we must warn you that this type of behavior is universally considered either rude or amorous, which could get you either killed or married.
These guys are scary looking. It wouldn't be a good idea to mess with them.
You'd best stay out of sight of this guy!
Don't throw the bunny at the Sequel Policeman! He may have a hare trigger.
This guy (or is it a gal?) doesn't look like anybody or anything you've ever seen before.
The being, unable to understand your language, acts as though it doesn't see you.
Taking in a whiff of air, you instantly notice it has three feet.
This guy looks like The Living Torso. He probably works for an intergalactic freak show.
It doesn't have the slightest notion as to what you might be saying.
Uhmm! Sulfur! This shopper smells as though it comes from a planet where the only showers are volcanic ones.
No way! That would be assualt with intent to emit battery!
This belt way is great! No more tired, aching feet. No more walking just for the sake of going somewhere.
You scrape some coating from the surface of the belt. Now there's probably toe jam from all corners of the universe wedged up under your fingernail!
You attempt to smell the moving walkway and end up filing down your nose slightly.
Very well, you give the moving walkway a warm kiss. Now you both feel special.
It's just another vital part of the Galaxy Galleria Shopping Mall.
Droid-O-Death
This is the only form of actual life that you've seen here! Its clothes are tattered and a grotesque metal contraption is clamped to its head which serves to hold the eyelids permanently open.
He seems to be unaware of your existence, as though he is controlled by some other consciousness.
Being downwind of the cyborg you are very aware that it smells like a slice of luncheon meat that's been walking around in the sun too long.
Not with your tongue!
You took a little too long. Now it's slime time!
A green gel-type mass flows out the vent and down the conduit section.

A blob of slime has gained an attraction for you. Is the green, viscous, congealed wad of bile helper bent on your destruction? Or is it just a friendly puddle of scum looking for a new friend? Dare you find out?
You bend down and scoop up some slime with both hands cupped.
You wave at the slime.
That has no effect on the green slime!
You have all of that toxic spew that you wish to carry.
Not quite yet... wait until it's in the right position!
Too late! You'd need longer arms to reach it from here.
Either you or the slime will have to be in a different position for that. Try waiting until it stops moving.
Get just a little bit closer!
You are not quite close enough!
The slime's already too far away! Perhaps it's a personal hygiene problem on your part.
You are not in a good position for that.
You can't do that from where you stand.
You're too far away to do that.
You taste a tiny bit of the green slime. Instantly, several recent fillings dissolve into a puddle of silver amalgam.
What were you expecting, Lime Slime? You notice a burning sensation when you get a strong whiff.
You scoop up the slimy secretion. Better get away now before it scoops you up!
The pipes running along the sides of this conduit are coated in inert slime.
You really don't want to touch the slime-laden pipes.
The pipes have the tangy taste of 100% real steel, basted with slime and rusted to a delicate crunch.
The corrosive effect of the slimy pipes reduces your tongue to a stump. Now you truly are tasteless!
Your nostrils flare as you inhale the fragrant aroma of cold steel with just a hint of sewage.
This is a section of the Xenon sewer system. Fortunately, there seems to be very little of the secret ingredient usually associated with sewers.
This rough area tastes strangely like blood. Oh, that IS blood. You shredded your tongue. Your mother should have warned you about licking strange areas!
It smells like cotton candy, roses, and and fresh roasted peanuts. Yeah, right!
The stench lingering in this sewer reminds you of your clothes hamper!
Your tongue won't reach up there.
Your nose isn't long enough to reach the vent.
You can't quite reach the vent.
You see some dripping, oozing stuff.
There's nothing you could do with the dripping liquid.
You don't need to do that.
You don't really want to do that.
It smells just like you thought it would.
This is Buford! You there, Delphoid? I found Wilco... repeat, I found Wilco!
Let's split up, I'll check out Wilco's time pod. Our sensors picked up some movement near there.
Yeah, Wilco is around here somewhere. I'll search the vicinity.
This is Delphoid! You there, Buford? I found Wilco... repeat, I found Wilco!
Let's split up, I'll check out Wilco's time pod.
A Sequel Policeman! Better keep a low profile.
Meanwhile, on another part of the planet....
Oh No!! The Sequel Police!!
